requirement.evidence: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
requirement.note: Also supported: sale/license ban in 98.1103(a); tenant remedies in 98.1104(a) with injunctive relief, damages, civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, and attorney's fees. The "set or recommend" wording tracks the definition of algorithmic device.

key_value.evidence: A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation of this Division, in a civil action against a landlord.
key_value.note: The document also states that each month a violation continues, and each residential rental property where a device is used, is a separate and distinct violation.

citation.evidence: Amend San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8 by adding new Division 11, sections 98.1101, 98.1102, 98.1103, and 98.1104, to adopt the proposed Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance.
citation.note: Sections 98.1101-98.1104 and draft Ord. O-2025-107 match the document. Section 98.1103 holds the prohibitions, and the remedies are in 98.1104.
